info.title: Destruction Lists
info.description: System register for destruction lists: the objects due for destruction, the reviewer and answer of each entry, the approvals of the list and its decision history. Name it in the archival setting (destructionListRegister, destructionListSchema) so the destruction sweep and the review endpoints have a home for their lists.

x-openregister.description: Foundational destruction-list register shipped by OpenRegister; backs the destruction review the archival endpoints serve.

destruction-lists.title: Destruction Lists
destruction-lists.description: Destruction lists under review: entries, reviewers, answers, approvals and the decision history.

destructionList.title: Destruction List
destructionList.summary: A list of objects due for destruction, reviewed entry by entry before it is approved and executed.
destructionList.description: The record of one destruction round: the objects whose disposal date has passed, who reviews each entry and what they answered, the approvals of the list and the one decision history an auditor reads. The archival setting names this register and schema (destructionListRegister, destructionListSchema); the destruction sweep writes lists here and the review endpoints read them.

title.title: Title
title.description: A name for the round, for people reading the list.

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: User id that built the list, or system for the sweep.

objectCount.title: Object count
objectCount.description: How many objects the list holds.

objects.title: Entries
objects.description: The objects under review, one entry each.

uuid.title: Object UUID
uuid.description: UUID of the object this entry is about.

title.title: Title
title.description: Name of the object, as the reviewer reads it.

archiefactiedatum.title: Disposal date
archiefactiedatum.description: The date the object is due for its archival action (archiefactiedatum).

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: The archival action due: vernietigen or bewaren.

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: User id of the person who has to sign this entry off; null while nobody is assigned.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: The reviewer's answer (destroy, retain or transfer); null while pending.

decidedBy.title: Decided by
decidedBy.description: User id of the person who answered.

softDeleted.title: Soft deleted
softDeleted.description: Whether the object was already soft-deleted when the list was built.

wooGepubliceerd.title: Woo published
wooGepubliceerd.description: Whether the object was published under the Woo.

excluded.title: Excluded
excluded.description: Objects taken off the list, with the reason.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Who approved the list, and when.

rejections.title: Rejections
rejections.description: Who rejected the list, and why.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: The one decision history: every destroy, retain and transfer answer, in order.

certificateUuid.title: Certificate
certificateUuid.description: UUID of the destruction certificate once the list is executed.
